## Current objective
Fix incorrect Canadian province tax calculation for Quebec (QST) in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`. Keep commits small for easy review.

Superseded/paused: OpenTelemetry tracing spans for the invoice sync worker. Do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` until a proposed diff is posted in `#privacy-review` and approved by `@mina`.

## Recent work
Search rebuild performance was optimized by tenant-scoping invoice scans, sharing a batched `EmbeddingClient`, and bulk-upserting vectors in one transaction. Added migration `0042_add_search_vector_tenant_document.py` for a unique `(tenant_id, document_id)` index. Validation passed: full suite has 247 passed, 4 skipped; 10,000-document benchmark median improved from 16.73s to 2.41s.

CSV export encoding was corrected by explicitly opening report files with UTF-8 in `ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py`. Added a UTF-8 regression case containing `Zoë,東京`; all 8 CSV tests pass, and MIME inspection reports `text/csv; charset=utf-8`.

Quebec tax work has not yet begun. The Kafka repartition offset migration was paused after the group was stopped and offsets described; no migration completion commands were run. Staging writes must use Redis `cache-eu-3`, not draining `cache-eu-1`.
